name: @rf.minimal/app2
author: Brian McBarron <brian@realityfoil.com> (https://realityfoil.com)
// imports: DNS: Ensure only server-side code can read from #pkg.

scripts.auth:perm: bash expand.sh gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding %_service_account --member=user:brian@mcbarron.net --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
scripts.preauth: bash expand.sh gcloud config configurations activate %_config
scripts.preunauth: gcloud config configurations activate default && bash expand.sh gcloud config configurations delete %_config
scripts.postclean: bash expand.sh rm -rf .firebase/%_project && bash m svelte-init
scripts.postpostclean: rm -f static/assets && bash expand.sh ENV_MSYS=winsymlinks:nativestrict ln -s ../../assets/public static/assets
scripts.dev.debug: bash expand.sh ENV_NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect vite --configLoader runner dev
scripts.site:canary: bash expand.sh %_fb_cli hosting:channel:deploy canary --only %_target && echo || bash expand.sh echo See %./firebase-debug.log
scripts.site:prod: bash expand.sh %_fb_cli deploy --only hosting:%_target && echo || bash expand.sh echo See %./firebase-debug.log
scripts.deploy:site:canary: bash m run-all site:versionup site:canary site:showversion
scripts.deploy:site:prod-unsafe: bash m run-all site:versionup site:prod site:showversion
